command: uv run lc eval retrieval --channel lexical --full --serial --workers 1 --csv benchmarks/codebench/results/retrieval_release_2026-09-21.csv
notes: Local LemonCrow uses lexical retrieval; hosted-only Zoekt and semantic channels are intentionally excluded.
Each MRR query is independent and uses code_search(force=true) so session repeat-query suppression cannot blank benchmark cases.
Frozen repository snapshots are routed to the current project-local workspace store and evaluation fails closed on empty snapshots.
